spots.name: Diamond Peak
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 3,223 m (10,575 ft).

spots.name: Newark Lake
spots.tip: A lake: calm air at dawn gives mirror reflections, and mist often sits on the water on cold mornings. The pin marks the middle of the lake: pick a shore spot facing the light.

spots.name: Eureka
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 117 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L869907.
